//: Composite indexes for the Firestore metrics backend (metrics/store_firestore.py). Deploy with: gcloud firestore indexes composite create --project=<PROJECT> --collection-group=sessions --query-scope=COLLECTION --field-config field-path=owner,order=ASCENDING --field-config field-path=timestamp,order=ASCENDING --field-config field-path=estimated_cost,order=ASCENDING   (repeat without `owner` for the owner-token path). get_cost_estimate(period_seconds=...) falls back to a client-side sum when these are absent, so they are a performance optimization, not a correctness requirement.
